unit.why: §קטו is a short anecdote: the rebbe, visiting Warsaw, calls on the Hemdat Shlomo, is posed an exegetical-halakhic question, answers it at once and is praised; §קטז is a teaching on a Rashi comment with no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: division also contains a non-narrative teaching (§קטז); the numbered-saying series continues before and after

stories.start_quote: ראיתי בכת"י חתנו הרב ר׳ אלחנן ז"ל
stories.summary_en: While in Warsaw, the tsaddik visits the Gaon author of Hemdat Shlomo, who asks him how Isaac could tithe by estimate; he answers at once from Mishnah Gittin, and the Gaon praises the answer as true.

tags.why: the question turns on the law against tithing by estimate
